# LuxAlgo Smart Money Concepts source

This folder preserves the open-source Pine Script published by LuxAlgo as **Smart Money Concepts (SMC) [LuxAlgo]**.

- Original TradingView publication: https://www.tradingview.com/script/CnB3fSph-Smart-Money-Concepts-SMC-LuxAlgo/
- Copyright: © LuxAlgo
- License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
- License text: [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt)
- Script: [SmartMoneyConcepts_LuxAlgo.pine](SmartMoneyConcepts_LuxAlgo.pine)

The source was retrieved from a public mirror of the TradingView open-source script. TradingView identifies the original publication as an open-source LuxAlgo indicator and describes its internal/swing BOS and CHoCH, order blocks, equal highs/lows, FVG, prior highs/lows, and premium/discount zones.

**Status in AURUM X:** source archive only. The current Python/Kotlin `_market_structure` / `structure()` routines are independent implementations, not a faithful execution of this Pine Script. Do not describe the current app build as running the official LuxAlgo indicator until a compatible runtime or TradingView alert bridge has been integrated and parity-tested.

Any shared adaptation must preserve LuxAlgo attribution, identify modifications, be non-commercial, and use CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (or a compatible license). This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by LuxAlgo or TradingView.
